McCalpin STREAM 5.10

The integration builds the unmodified native source file
`streams/stream_omp_5_10.c`, fetched from
https://github.com/redhat-performance/streams-wrapper at commit
`8932e7bfa6cf1c99360c10549887eeb1d457d27e`. The native source is separately
licensed under the terms retained in `STREAM-5.10-LICENSE.txt`; the wrapper
repository's license excludes that file. Workshop verifies the native source
SHA-256 and installs generated executables, not the wrapper repository or its
helpers.
